title: Source enumeration and initial identity acquisition
scope: Enumerate and identify one finite source selection before/while publication.
proposed_work_bound: O(N + B + D + directory entries actually selected); add S(N) only for required canonical ordering. A repeated watcher rescan is separately counted, not hidden in a per-file constant.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(window) byte buffers; O(N + D) durable/spooled identity inventory permissible; no RAM proportional to total payload.
semantic_requirement: Equal bytes do not collapse distinct members; path changes, symlinks and source mutation preserve exact custody semantics.
proposed_witness: Vary member count at fixed total bytes and one-file bytes at fixed count; include zero/tiny files, long paths, duplicate content and mutation during hash.

title: Upload registration and canonical construction planning
scope: Complete registration/plan sequence for a one-shot or incremental collection.
proposed_work_bound: O(N + O + E + D) logical work plus I(N+O+E,Z) and any one declared initial S(N); no per-append complete registration/plan/inventory rebuild.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded requests and transactions; disk/durable state O(N+O+E+D). A page size is not a total member limit.
semantic_requirement: Equivalent admitted inputs yield exact equivalent construction authority; wrong sessions, identities, continuations and duplicates fail closed.
proposed_witness: Count all append/plan operations for growing N, not just one call; cross pack and source-edge boundaries and resume at several frontiers.

title: Payload packing and transfer
scope: Upload a complete byte/pack/segment set at fixed configured windows.
proposed_work_bound: O(B + N + O); provider contacts O(O + bytes/transfer-unit), plus explicitly counted retries. No whole-pack reserialization or re-encryption after every member.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(concurrency * transfer window + bounded unsealed pack workspace), independent of collection bytes; retained source payload belongs to its custody owner.
semantic_requirement: Direct-to-final ciphertext and pack/raw exact identity, receipt validation and bounded plaintext exposure remain unchanged.
proposed_witness: Counter tests on successive member/segment writes; actual encryption/storage runs across at least three pack seals with failure and lost-receipt recovery.

title: Per-artifact custody and reconciliation
scope: Obtain exact custody for all members and reconcile at publication/retry boundaries.
proposed_work_bound: O(N + O + E + D) total productive reconciliation plus I(N+O,Z); explicit status observations add O(p+log Z) each, not O(all pending N) per appended file.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded ready/pending frontiers; unsealed local source data retained until exact receipt; queue/state totals may be O(N).
semantic_requirement: No safe release at registration or pack seal alone; only complete verified receipt authorizes release.
proposed_witness: Include history-delayed and payload-delayed members, unsealed packs and fair receipt polling; count rows re-registered and scanned over entire publication.

title: Finalization, metadata publication and root commitment
scope: Finish a collection with all required histories, manifests, roots and discovery readiness accounted.
proposed_work_bound: O(N + O + H + E + D) distinct structural work plus I(N+O+E,Z), ordering and declared graph/index costs. Do not multiply a shared completion document by output count.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded construction windows/transactions, O(N+O+H+E+D) durable/spilled evidence; cryptographic object cost charged by G04.
semantic_requirement: Root-last, complete selected closure, producer-authored completion and ordered receipt checkpoints; discovery completion cost stays in the lifecycle.
proposed_witness: Trace every finalization phase and unique object/journal validation; shared-completion fixtures and out-of-order publication failures; compare exact roots and independent recovery.

title: Exact retrieval selection and authenticated byte ranges
scope: Plan selected members/ranges and deliver authenticated bytes.
proposed_work_bound: Warm selection O(k + D_selection + I(k,Z)); range work O(b + touched authentication-unit bytes + selected metadata). Cold archive preparation may add one O(N+O+H) pass, explicitly scoped and shared within a lifecycle.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded range/cache windows and selection pages; no full-file buffering for a range. O(index size) disk scratch may be required for cold preparation.
semantic_requirement: No claim of O(requested bytes) when a whole authenticated segment must be verified; never reread all archive descriptors for every selected member.
proposed_witness: Small ranges across segment boundaries in one large file; many members in the same pack; cold/warm/evicted selection, truncation and wrong-root negatives.

title: Retrieval hydration, placement and accounting
scope: Hydrate/cache selected immutable objects and maintain exact accounting.
proposed_work_bound: O(bytes hydrated + objects affected + lease/accounting changes) plus indexed lookups; one startup/accounting rebuild O(retained records), not a full scan on each access.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(configured crypto/transfer/cache budgets); persistent usage O(retained objects + active leases). Capacity bypass/rejection explicit, no silent partial read.
semantic_requirement: Replica/incarnation choice, cache receipt authentication, quota and eviction fences remain live.
proposed_witness: Vary unrelated cached-object population separately; full-cache eviction, concurrent hydration, partial failure and accounting rebuild.

title: Portable path planning and materialization
scope: Plan collision-safe destinations and write a requested selected set.
proposed_work_bound: O(path bytes + N + B_written) plus S(N) for deterministic collision/order resolution and indexed lookup; no pairwise path comparison on a sparse set.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded file buffers; materialized pure helper may use O(path inventory); spooled path planner must not require all members in RAM.
semantic_requirement: Preserve platform equivalence, case/Unicode behavior, path safety, deterministic collision names and bytes.
proposed_witness: Case/Unicode/prefix collisions and long paths; one large versus many tiny files; compare spooled and in-memory planner outputs.

title: Archive copy and replication
scope: Copy a selected exact archive closure to requested replicas.
proposed_work_bound: O(Copies * (B + O + metadata bytes)) plus per-copy index/receipt work; no rediscovery of the entire object list per copied object.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Fixed concurrent transfer windows and O(objects) checkpoint records; provider latency excluded, all attempts counted.
semantic_requirement: Immutable exact source/copy identity, independent verification, descriptor/root ordering and retry receipt stability.
proposed_witness: Increase object count and copy count separately, then combine; fail a late unit and prove bounded replay and unchanged source authority.

title: Guarded deletion and copy retirement
scope: Build and execute an explicit deletion/retirement plan.
proposed_work_bound: O(affected objects + metadata + actual guard dependencies) plus indexed access; scalar status/cancel independent of full plan size; no growing-prefix plan rehash each delete.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded deletion batches and retained operation checkpoints; invalidation/revalidation scopes explicitly sized.
semantic_requirement: Fresh challenge/authorization, required remaining-copy checks, exact action set and no destruction of unselected custody.
proposed_witness: Unrelated catalog growth, many-object plan, stale challenge, retry after partial deletion and loss of authority.

title: Mutable descriptions and classification tags
scope: Change/read description or tag revision independently of immutable inventory.
proposed_work_bound: Description O(description bytes + affected copies); tag delta O(delta tag bytes + delta * log(2+T) + affected copy contacts). Full tag enumeration O(tag bytes + T), plus page startup I(pages,Z); independent of N and payload B.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Working state bounded by mutation/page sizes; retained revisions grow with genuine retained changes, not copies of unchanged collection inventory.
semantic_requirement: Exact revision identity, stale-writer fencing, old-head protection and retained-history semantics remain.
proposed_witness: Hold tag set/delta fixed while increasing collection members; count inventory visits/hashes (must remain zero for a pure tag update); replay stale writes.

title: Orphans, scratch cleanup, expiry and cache sweeps
scope: Discover due/stale owned work and safely reclaim resources.
proposed_work_bound: O(due/abandoned entries + bytes actually reclaimed) plus indexed scheduler/owner lookups; full census, where required, O(retained entries) per explicitly declared sweep, never per completed member.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded sweep batches, no unbounded transaction; active leases protected. Restart may scan recovery metadata once, not rehash every archived payload.
semantic_requirement: Custodied orphan sessions remain resumable; cancellation is not proof work stopped; live scratch not deleted.
proposed_witness: Kill owners, retain live owners, grow expired and unrelated active populations separately; count examined entries and replayed units.
